segments.sn35.54:1.1: “Kathaṃ nu kho, bhante, jānato, kathaṃ passato, saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti?
segments.sn35.54:1.2: “Cakkhuṃ kho, bhikkhu, aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahīyanti.
segments.sn35.54:1.3: Rūpe … cakkhuviññāṇaṃ … cakkhusamphassaṃ … yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahīyanti.
segments.sn35.54:1.7: Sotaṃ … ghānaṃ … jivhaṃ … kāyaṃ … manaṃ … dhamme … manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphassaṃ … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato saṃyojanā pahīyanti.
segments.sn35.54:1.16: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato saṃyojanā pahīyantī”ti.
